statement.text:
b) For a finite group X, let χ1 (X) denote the totality of the degrees of all
irreducible complex characters of X with allowance for their multiplicities. Suppose
that χ1 (G) = χ1 (H) for groups G and H. Clearly, then |G| = |H|. Is it true that H
is soluble if G is soluble?
    It is known that H is a Frobenius group if G is a Frobenius group.
                                                                     Ya. G. Berkovich
